title: Claude Fable 5 returns to the text API
summary:
Claude Fable 5 returns to the unified text API, while the app directory and project news keep themselves current.

Claude Fable 5 is back through Bedrock for paid text workloads, including adaptive thinking support. Developers have another capable model available through the same unified endpoint; software continues its ancient ritual of removing a model and then finding it again.

Automated updates refreshed community app health and usage data in the directory, while the repository README's Latest News section caught up with the day.
